title: Sectionwise finite projection of the ordinary quotient pullback mate
statement: Fix the data of lem-sf-pull-quotient-ordinary-projection, a cochain degree i, a pro-etale object V of X and a section x of the pulled complex in degree i. The degree-i section of the nth projected ordinary quotient pullback mate equals the degree-i section of the nth quotient augmentation followed by p.tower.

source.place: Maps-used sentence, sectionwise finite projection calculation.

proof.text: Apply CategoryTheory.unit_conjugateEquiv to the two composite ordinary adjunctions. The definition of OrdinaryLimitModel.reductionPull identifies its right-adjoint conjugate with a.comparison. Evaluate the resulting equality on a section of P.X i after the completed-ring pullback unit, then apply a.projections at the finite level n.

Naturality of limit.π and the restriction/evaluation comparison moves the sequence pullback unit through the finite projection. The chosen reduction-evaluation and inverse-image-evaluation isomorphisms satisfy their stated adjunction-unit equations. Cancel the inverse evaluation maps and use naturality of the finite pullback unit. The projected mate sends the completed pullback unit of x to the finite pullback unit of 1 tensor x.

The normalization of IntegralOnSlice.augmentation sends the pulled-back unit of x to its quotient generator. Apply p.generators: its image under p.tower is the same finite pullback unit of 1 tensor x. Injectivity of the completed-ring pullback adjunction Hom equivalence and sectionwise extensionality give equality of the two module maps, not merely equality on unit sections.

Use the prescribed finite component of pullbackTensorPullbackTower to replace the composite restriction/evaluation and inverse finite comparisons. The complex-composition comparison is the identity in each degree. Evaluate the equality of module maps at the original arbitrary pro-etale object V and section x.

proof_origin.place: Sectionwise ordinary projection calculation; formalized from the composite adjunction unit identity, the finite evaluation normalizations, and the prescribed pull-tower generator equation by M5.

from.place: sectionwise reduction of the projected cochain-map identity

theorem pullQuotientOrdinaryProjection_section
    (a : IntegralSystemRealization.OrdinaryLimitModel l E)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : OpenFactorCoherence.Pull l E f)
    (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ) (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ)
    (V : X.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (x : (((OpenFactorCoherence.pullCx l E f).obj P).X i).val.obj V) :
    (((((pullbackTensorOrdinaryAdjunction l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).unit.app
      ((OpenFactorCoherence.pullCx l E f).obj P) ≫
      ((pullbackTensorOrdinaryLimit l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        (a.reductionPullComplex l E f P) ≫
      (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
        (Iso.refl (coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X ⋙
          pullbackTensorConstantLimit l E X)) (.up ℤ)).inv.app
        (((pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ≫
      (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (lim.π (op n)) (.up ℤ)).app
        (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
            (((pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))) ≫
      (pullbackTensorPullbackTower l E f P).hom.app (op n)).f i).val.app V x) =
      (((((IntegralOnSlice.augmentation l E X none).app
        ((OpenFactorCoherence.pullCx l E f).obj P)).app (op n) ≫
        (p.tower.hom.app P).app (op n)).f i).val.app V x)
